headline:
Cheap, steady,
but growth has stalled
chart_note: 52-week range: $279.10 - $366.50. Currently around $357, near the top of that range despite tepid recent earnings growth.
why_today: Down 1.2% today but still trading near its 52-week high ($366.50) - cheap on a PE basis, though recent earnings growth has been flat to slightly negative.
pro_1: PE of 15.4x is inexpensive relative to the market and to other mega-caps - a reasonable price for the largest US bank
pro_2: Trading near 52-week highs with a Buy consensus (24 analysts) and a steady 1.7% dividend
con_1: Full-year EPS growth was just 1.3% in 2025, and the most recent quarter actually declined 3.7% YoY - earnings momentum has stalled
con_2: Average price target implies only about 3% upside - modest reward for the risk at current levels
